stem.text: Antibiotic resistance is a serious threat to global health.
Which statement describes a step that can be taken to reduce the impact of antibiotic resistance?

A.text: Antibiotics prescribed by a doctor should be shared with family members to protect them.

B.text: Antibiotics should only be used to treat infectious diseases caused by viruses.

C.text: Farmers should give antibiotics to healthy animals to prevent infections occurring.

D.text: Vaccination programmes should be used to reduce the spread of bacterial diseases.
